text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So you came, Vodka.
Without running away from this battle for the crown.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Like hell I'm gonna chicken out after being told to come if I'm free!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You've got some nerve. Hey, since we're competing anyway,
how about a little side entertainment?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The winner of this race is the Queen. How about the loser
has to obey whatever the Queen says for one whole day?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat? 'Queen for a Day'?
What a worthless game you've come up with..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm gonna do it! Got that?
Don't go playing dumb just 'cause you lose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't do that.
After all, I have no intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should I order you to do?
Fufun♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch, getting all full of yourself.
I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'd better think of
what to order that guy to do!
